page.overview:
What is Record of Days?

The Record of Days is a text crafted by the survivors of Amonkhet after the terror of the Hour of Devastation and the Phyrexian invasion. It charts a path toward a golden era that can only be built collectively.

During Bolas's reign, the Accounting of Hours was the primary religious text of the Amonkheti. Upon the revelations of Bolas's lies, the faith of the people of Amonkhet was shattered. Nevertheless, faith remained, and sought a home. The survivors craft the Record of Days, a text that combines the yearning faith of the turbulent past with the guarded hope of better days to come. Three deities have been revealed in the text: Hazoret, who was known. Two others, Sab-Sunen and Ketramose, are new, having revealed themselves to the people of Amonkhet in the wake of the Phyrexian invasion.

Category:In-multiverse works Category:Prophecies
